caption:
Can open source AI models really compete with Anthropic's premium pricing?

Anthropic still leads AI spend despite open source rise. According to Vercel's AI gateway dashboard, Anthropic accounts for more than half of the overall AI spend on the platform.

The rise of open source AI models hasn't hurt Anthropic's business. In fact, Anthropic's share of AI spend has remained steady, even as open source models like DeepSeek have gained popularity.

DeepSeek has surged into the lead for token volumes on Vercel's AI gateway, processing just over a third of the tokens passing through the company's infrastructure. However, Anthropic's premium token price helps it maintain its lead in overall spend.

The AI economy may be shifting towards a two-tiered model, with frontier labs like Anthropic dominating early-stage deployments and open source models taking over as use cases mature. This could be a relatively stable feature of the AI economy going forward.
